verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a native MCP server that lets an AI client create indexes, add documents, configure settings and run searches, all without a dashboard. Its single API and typed SDKs give agents a programmatic path as well. Missing for 10: no documented CLI for these operations, no explicit REST endpoint documentation for index creation or document upload in the pack, no published OpenAPI spec found by the probe, and no hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full loop.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can create an index, add documents, and run queries end to end — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: Once configured, you can create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches using natural language prompts.
Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route so any MCP-compatible client can search your indexes directly.
Index documents, tune ranking rules, and search Meilisearch through natural conversation in the AI client you already use.
It stores your documents and embeddings, then exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API.
